title: Area of Triangles, Parallelograms and Trapezoids
seo_title: Grade 6 Area of Triangles, Parallelograms and Trapezoids Worksheets (TEKS 6.8, STAAR)
short_title: Area of Triangles, Parallelograms and Trapezoids
standard_text: 6.8B model area formulas for parallelograms, trapezoids, and triangles by decomposing and rearranging parts of these shapes; 6.8C write equations that represent problems related to the area of rectangles, parallelograms, trapezoids, and triangles and volume of right rectangular prisms where dimensions are positive rational numbers; 6.8D determine solutions for problems involving the area of rectangles, parallelograms, trapezoids, and triangles and volume of right rectangular prisms where dimensions are positive rational numbers
meta_desc: Free Grade 6 area worksheets for Texas TEKS 6.8B, 6.8C and 6.8D: area of triangles, parallelograms and trapezoids, composite figures and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Parallelogram b × h, triangle ½ × b × h, trapezoid ½ × (b₁ + b₂) × h.
key_sub: The height is perpendicular to the base.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Parallelogram: A = b × h. Cut a triangle from one end and move it to make a rectangle.
  • Triangle: A = 12 × b × h. Two copies make a parallelogram.
  • Trapezoid: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h.
  • The height is always perpendicular to the base, not a slanted side.

Examples

Example

Triangle: b = 10 cm, h = 7 cm

1/2 × 10 × 7

Answer: 35 cm²

Example

Trapezoid: bases 6 m and 10 m, h = 4 m

1/2 × (6 + 10) × 4

Answer: 32 m²

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the 1/2 for a triangleA triangle is half of a parallelogram.
Using a slanted side as the heightThe height meets the base at a right angle.
Using only one base of a trapezoidAdd both bases, then multiply by h and 1/2.

faq.q: Why is a triangle half of b × h?
faq.a: Two copies of the same triangle make a parallelogram with area b × h.
Square units, such as cm² or ft².

items.q: What is the area of the right triangle?
items.e: The two sides that meet at the right angle are the base and the height. A = 12 × 3 × 4 = 12 × 12 = 6 square centimeters. The 5 cm side is slanted, so it is not the height.

items.q: What is the area of the right triangle?

items.q: What is the area of the right triangle?
items.e: The two sides that meet at the right angle are the base and the height. A = 12 × 7 × 10 = 12 × 70 = 35 ft².

items.q: A diagonal cuts this rectangle into two equal triangles. What is the area of the shaded triangle?
items.e: The rectangle is 12 × 10 = 120 square meters. The shaded triangle is half of it: 120 ÷ 2 = 60 square meters.

items.q: A diagonal cuts this rectangle into two equal triangles. What is the area of the shaded triangle?
items.e: The rectangle is 13 × 5 = 65 in². The shaded triangle is half of it: 65 ÷ 2 = 32.5 in².

items.q: A diagonal cuts this rectangle into two equal triangles. What is the area of the shaded triangle?
items.e: The rectangle is 15 × 8 = 120 ft². The shaded triangle is half of it: 120 ÷ 2 = 60 ft².

items.q: A diagonal cuts this rectangle into two equal triangles. What is the area of the shaded triangle?
items.e: The rectangle is 14 × 6 = 84 square centimeters. The shaded triangle is half of it: 84 ÷ 2 = 42 square centimeters.

items.q: The two sides that meet at the right angle of a right triangle are 9 cm and 14 cm long. What is the area of the triangle?
items.e: A = 12 × 9 × 14 = 12 × 126 = 63 square centimeters. Do not forget the 12: a triangle is half of a rectangle.

items.q: The two sides that meet at the right angle of a right triangle are 7 ft and 11 ft long. What is the area of the triangle?
items.e: A = 12 × 7 × 11 = 12 × 77 = 38.5 ft². Do not forget the 12: a triangle is half of a rectangle.

items.q: A right triangle has sides that are 8 m, 6 m and 10 m long. What is its area?
items.e: The longest side (10 m) is across from the right angle, so it is slanted. Use the two shorter sides: A = 12 × 8 × 6 = 12 × 48 = 24 square meters.

items.q: A right triangle has sides that are 20 in, 21 in and 29 in long. What is its area?
items.e: The longest side (29 in) is across from the right angle, so it is slanted. Use the two shorter sides: A = 12 × 20 × 21 = 12 × 420 = 210 in².

items.q: Which expression gives the area of this right triangle?
items.e: Use the two sides that make the right angle: they are the base and the height. 12 × 15 × 20 = 150 in². 15 × 20 forgets the 12, and 25 in is the slanted side.

items.q: Which expression gives the area of this right triangle?
items.e: Use the two sides that make the right angle: they are the base and the height. 12 × 5 × 12 = 30 ft². 5 × 12 forgets the 12, and 13 ft is the slanted side.

items.q: A right triangle has an area of 30 ft². One of the sides that meet at the right angle is 5 ft. How long is the other one?
items.e: 12 × 5 × ? = 30, so 5 × ? = 30 × 2 = 60. 60 ÷ 5 = 12 ft. Check: 12 × 5 × 12 = 12 × 60 = 30.

items.q: A right triangle has an area of 42 square centimeters. One of the sides that meet at the right angle is 12 cm. How long is the other one?
items.e: 12 × 12 × ? = 42, so 12 × ? = 42 × 2 = 84. 84 ÷ 12 = 7 cm. Check: 12 × 12 × 7 = 12 × 84 = 42.

items.q: What is the area of the triangle?

items.q: What is the area of the triangle?

items.q: A triangle has a base of 7.5 m and a height of 4 m. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × 7.5 × 4 = 12 × 30 = 15 square meters.

items.q: A triangle has a base of 12 in and a height of 6.5 in. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × 12 × 6.5 = 12 × 78 = 39 in².

items.q: A triangle has a base of 9 ft and a height of 5 ft. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × 9 × 5 = 12 × 45 = 22.5 ft².

items.q: A triangle has a base of 15 cm and a height of 8.4 cm. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × 15 × 8.4 = 12 × 126 = 63 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangle has an area of 36 square centimeters. Its base is 9 cm. What is its height?
items.e: 12 × 9 × ? = 36. Double the area first: 36 × 2 = 72. Then 72 ÷ 9 = 8 cm. Check: 12 × 9 × 8 = 12 × 72 = 36 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangle has an area of 42 square meters. Its height is 7 m. What is its base?
items.e: 12 × 7 × ? = 42. Double the area first: 42 × 2 = 84. Then 84 ÷ 7 = 12 m. Check: 12 × 7 × 12 = 12 × 84 = 42 square meters.

items.q: Which expression gives the area of the triangle?
items.e: The base is 11 m. The height is the dashed 12 m line, which meets the base line at a right angle outside the triangle. A = 12 × 11 × 12 = 66 square meters.

items.q: Which expression gives the area of the triangle?
items.e: The base is 4 ft. The height is the dashed 12 ft line, which meets the base line at a right angle outside the triangle. A = 12 × 4 × 12 = 24 ft².

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 16 × 9 = 144 square centimeters. The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 15 cm side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 16 by 9.)

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 13 × 12 = 156 square meters. The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 15 m side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 13 by 12.)

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 12 × 15 = 180 in². The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 17 in side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 12 by 15.)

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 13 × 6 = 78 ft². The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 10 ft side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 13 by 6.)

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 8 × 3 = 24 square centimeters. The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 5 cm side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 8 by 3.)

items.q: What is the area of the parallelogram?
items.e: A = base × height = 16 × 12 = 192 square meters. The height is the dashed line at a right angle to the base, not the slanted 13 m side. (Cut off the triangle on one end and move it to the other end: you get a rectangle that is 16 by 12.)

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (12 + 6) × 4 = 12 × 18 × 4 = 36 square meters. The 5 m side is slanted, so it is not the height.

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (19 + 7) × 8 = 12 × 26 × 8 = 104 in². The 10 in side is slanted, so it is not the height.

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (17 + 10) × 8 = 12 × 27 × 8 = 108 ft².

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (20 + 10) × 12 = 12 × 30 × 12 = 180 square centimeters. The 13 cm side is slanted, so it is not the height.

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (17 + 5) × 8 = 12 × 22 × 8 = 88 square meters. The 10 m side is slanted, so it is not the height.

items.q: What is the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: A = 12 × (b1 + b2) × h = 12 × (11 + 6) × 4 = 12 × 17 × 4 = 34 in².

items.q: A parallelogram has a base of 8.5 ft and a height of 6 ft. What is its area?
items.e: A = base × height = 8.5 × 6 = 51 ft². No 12 here: a parallelogram is a rectangle with a slanted end moved.

items.q: A parallelogram has a base of 14 cm and a height of 11.5 cm. What is its area?
items.e: A = base × height = 14 × 11.5 = 161 square centimeters. No 12 here: a parallelogram is a rectangle with a slanted end moved.

items.q: A trapezoid has parallel sides of 12 m and 7.5 m. The distance between them (the height) is 4 m. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × (12 + 7.5) × 4 = 12 × 19.5 × 4 = 39 square meters.

items.q: A trapezoid has parallel sides of 10.5 in and 5.5 in. The distance between them (the height) is 7 in. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × (10.5 + 5.5) × 7 = 12 × 16 × 7 = 56 in².

items.q: A parallelogram has an area of 96 square meters. Its base is 12 m. What is its height?
items.e: Area = base × height, so 12 × ? = 96. 96 ÷ 12 = 8 m. Check: 12 × 8 = 96.

items.q: A trapezoid has parallel sides of 7 cm and 13 cm and an area of 60 square centimeters. What is its height?
items.e: 12 × (7 + 13) × h = 60, so 12 × 20 × h = 60, which is 10 × h = 60. h = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 cm. Check: 12 × 20 × 6 = 60.

items.q: Which expression gives the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: Add the two parallel sides, multiply by the height (the dashed line), and take half: 12 × (16 + 6) × 12 = 12 × 22 × 12 = 132 ft².

items.q: Which expression gives the area of the trapezoid?
items.e: Add the two parallel sides, multiply by the height (the dashed line), and take half: 12 × (14 + 8) × 4 = 12 × 22 × 4 = 44 square meters.

items.q: The dashed line splits the figure into two rectangles. What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Split it into two rectangles: 7 × 11 = 77 and 8 × 5 = 40. Add: 77 + 40 = 117 square centimeters. Use each part of the figure once: 7 × 11 + 15 × 5 = 152 counts the 7 × 5 corner twice.

items.q: The dashed line splits the figure into two rectangles. What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Split it into two rectangles: 6 × 7 = 42 and 4 × 3 = 12. Add: 42 + 12 = 54 square meters. Use each part of the figure once: 6 × 7 + 10 × 3 = 72 counts the 6 × 3 corner twice.

items.q: What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Whole rectangle 12 × 11 = 132, minus the missing corner 7 × 6 = 42: 132 − 42 = 90 in². Or: split it into two rectangles: 5 × 11 = 55 and 7 × 5 = 35. Add: 55 + 35 = 90 in².

items.q: What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Whole rectangle 16 × 10 = 160, minus the missing corner 7 × 6 = 42: 160 − 42 = 118 ft². Or: split it into two rectangles: 9 × 10 = 90 and 7 × 4 = 28. Add: 90 + 28 = 118 ft².

items.q: What is the area of the figure? Find the two missing side lengths first.
items.e: Missing sides: 12 − 5 = 7 and 10 − 6 = 4. Whole rectangle 12 × 10 = 120, minus the missing corner 7 × 4 = 28: 120 − 28 = 92 square centimeters.

items.q: What is the area of the figure? Find the two missing side lengths first.
items.e: Missing sides: 10 − 4 = 6 and 7 − 4 = 3. Whole rectangle 10 × 7 = 70, minus the missing corner 6 × 3 = 18: 70 − 18 = 52 square meters.

items.q: The figure is a rectangle with a triangle on top. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 10 × 7 = 70 square meters. Triangle: 12 × 10 × 3 = 12 × 30 = 15 square meters. Add: 70 + 15 = 85 square meters.

items.q: The figure is a rectangle with a triangle on top. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 14 × 10 = 140 in². Triangle: 12 × 14 × 3 = 12 × 42 = 21 in². Add: 140 + 21 = 161 in².

items.q: The figure is a rectangle with a triangle on top. What is its area?
items.e: The triangle is 14 − 10 = 4 ft tall. Rectangle: 14 × 10 = 140 ft². Triangle: 12 × 14 × 4 = 12 × 56 = 28 ft². Add: 140 + 28 = 168 ft².

items.q: The figure is a rectangle with a triangle on top. What is its area?
items.e: The triangle is 11 − 4 = 7 cm tall. Rectangle: 16 × 4 = 64 square centimeters. Triangle: 12 × 16 × 7 = 12 × 112 = 56 square centimeters. Add: 64 + 56 = 120 square centimeters.

items.q: What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Rectangle: 13 × 8 = 104 in². Triangle: its base is the 8 in side and its height is 7 in, so 12 × 8 × 7 = 12 × 56 = 28 in². Add: 104 + 28 = 132 in².

items.q: What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Rectangle: 8 × 4 = 32 ft². Triangle: its base is the 4 ft side and its height is 6 ft, so 12 × 4 × 6 = 12 × 24 = 12 ft². Add: 32 + 12 = 44 ft².

items.q: What is the area of the figure?
items.e: Rectangle: 12 × 6 = 72 square centimeters. Triangle: its base is the 6 cm side and its height is 5 cm, so 12 × 6 × 5 = 12 × 30 = 15 square centimeters. Add: 72 + 15 = 87 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangle is cut off the corner of a rectangle (gray dashed lines). What is the area of the shaded figure?
items.e: Whole rectangle: 14 × 10 = 140 ft². Cut-off right triangle: 12 × 4 × 5 = 12 × 20 = 10 ft². Subtract: 140 − 10 = 130 ft².

items.q: A triangle is cut off the corner of a rectangle (gray dashed lines). What is the area of the shaded figure?
items.e: Whole rectangle: 14 × 10 = 140 square centimeters. Cut-off right triangle: 12 × 5 × 4 = 12 × 20 = 10 square centimeters. Subtract: 140 − 10 = 130 square centimeters.

items.q: A triangle is cut off the corner of a rectangle (gray dashed lines). What is the area of the shaded figure?
items.e: Whole rectangle: 11 × 10 = 110 square meters. Cut-off right triangle: 12 × 3 × 5 = 12 × 15 = 7.5 square meters. Subtract: 110 − 7.5 = 102.5 square meters.

items.q: The dashed line splits the figure into a rectangle and a triangle. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 5 × 5 = 25 square centimeters. The triangle's base is 12 − 5 = 7 cm and its height is 5 cm: 12 × 7 × 5 = 12 × 35 = 17.5 square centimeters. Add: 25 + 17.5 = 42.5 square centimeters.

items.q: The dashed line splits the figure into a rectangle and a triangle. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 5 × 5 = 25 square meters. The triangle's base is 8 − 5 = 3 m and its height is 5 m: 12 × 3 × 5 = 12 × 15 = 7.5 square meters. Add: 25 + 7.5 = 32.5 square meters.

items.q: The hexagon is a rectangle with two equal triangles. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 12 × 8 = 96 square meters. Each triangle: base 8 m, height 3 m, so 12 × 8 × 3 = 12 × 24 = 12 square meters. Total: 96 + 12 + 12 = 120 square meters.

items.q: The hexagon is a rectangle with two equal triangles. What is its area?
items.e: Rectangle: 12 × 6 = 72 in². Each triangle: base 6 in, height 5 in, so 12 × 6 × 5 = 12 × 30 = 15 in². Total: 72 + 15 + 15 = 102 in².

items.q: Carlos's sailboat has a sail shaped like a right triangle. The bottom edge is 9 ft and the mast side is 16 ft. What is the area of the sail?
items.e: The bottom edge and the mast meet at a right angle. A = 12 × 9 × 16 = 12 × 144 = 72 ft².

items.q: A triangular flower bed has a base of 12 m and a height of 7.5 m. How much ground does it cover?
items.e: A = 12 × 12 × 7.5 = 12 × 90 = 45 square meters.

items.q: Mia sews 12 triangle pennants for a banner. Each pennant has a base of 10 in and a height of 18 in. How much fabric do the pennants use in all?
items.e: One pennant: 12 × 10 × 18 = 12 × 180 = 90 in². Twelve pennants: 12 × 90 = 1,080 in².

items.q: Each side panel of a skateboard ramp is a right triangle. The panel is 6 ft long on the ground and 1.5 ft tall. Both side panels get painted. How much area is painted?
items.e: One panel: 12 × 6 × 1.5 = 12 × 9 = 4.5 ft². Two panels: 2 × 4.5 = 9 ft².

items.q: Liam tiles a patio shaped like a trapezoid. The parallel sides are 14 ft and 10 ft, and they are 8 ft apart. Tile costs $4.50 per square foot. How much does the tile cost?
items.e: Area: 12 × (14 + 10) × 8 = 12 × 24 × 8 = 96 ft². Cost: 96 × $4.50 = $432.

items.q: A flag is a rectangle 6 ft long and 4 ft tall. A blue triangle on the flag has a base of 4 ft (the short side) and a height of 3 ft. The rest of the flag is white. What is the area of the white part?
items.e: Flag: 6 × 4 = 24 ft². Triangle: 12 × 4 × 3 = 12 × 12 = 6 ft². White part: 24 − 6 = 18 ft².

items.q: A parking space is shaped like a parallelogram. It is 10 ft wide along the curb, and the painted slanted lines are 20 ft long. The distance straight across from the curb to the back of the space is 18 ft. What is its area?
items.e: A = base × height = 10 × 18 = 180 ft². The 20 ft lines are slanted, so they are not the height.

items.q: An L-shaped lawn is a 40 ft by 30 ft rectangle with a 15 ft by 10 ft corner taken out for a patio. What is the area of the lawn?
items.e: Whole rectangle: 40 × 30 = 1,200 ft². Patio corner: 15 × 10 = 150 ft². Lawn: 1,200 − 150 = 1,050 ft².

items.q: Ximena paints the front wall of a shed. The wall is a rectangle 24 ft wide and 8 ft tall with a triangle on top that is 6 ft tall. How much area does she paint?
items.e: Rectangle: 24 × 8 = 192 ft². Triangle: 12 × 24 × 6 = 12 × 144 = 72 ft². Total: 192 + 72 = 264 ft².

items.q: A garden bed is a trapezoid. Its parallel sides are 3.5 m and 5.5 m, and the distance between them is 2 m. What is its area?
items.e: A = 12 × (3.5 + 5.5) × 2 = 12 × 9 × 2 = 9 square meters.

items.q: Jayden makes a triangle scarf. Its base is 1 12 yd and its height is 34 yd. How much fabric is in the scarf?
items.e: A = 12 × 1 12 × 34 = 12 × 1 18 = 916 yd².

items.q: A corner shelf is a right triangle. The two sides along the walls are each 34 ft long. What is the area of the shelf?
items.e: The two wall sides meet at a right angle. A = 12 × 34 × 34 = 12 × 916 = 932 ft².

items.q: A triangular sail has an area of 54 square meters. Its base is 9 m. How tall is the sail?
items.e: 12 × 9 × h = 54, so 9 × h = 108. h = 108 ÷ 9 = 12 m.

items.q: A field shaped like a parallelogram has an area of 1,200 square meters. Its base is 40 m. What is its height?
items.e: Area = base × height, so 40 × h = 1,200. h = 1,200 ÷ 40 = 30 m. (Halving is only for triangles and trapezoids.)

items.q: Triangle A has a base of 10 cm and a height of 8 cm. Parallelogram B has a base of 5 cm and a height of 8 cm. Which is true?
c: A is twice as large as B.
items.e: A: 12 × 10 × 8 = 12 × 80 = 40 square centimeters. B: 5 × 8 = 40 square centimeters. Same area. (Forgetting the 12 makes A look twice as large.)

items.q: A park is a rectangle 80 m long and 60 m wide. It has a triangular pond with a base of 20 m and a height of 15 m. The rest of the park is grass. What is the area of the grass?
items.e: Park: 80 × 60 = 4,800 square meters. Pond: 12 × 20 × 15 = 12 × 300 = 150 square meters. Grass: 4,800 − 150 = 4,650 square meters.

items.q: Elijah covers a stage shaped like a trapezoid with square tiles. The parallel sides are 20 ft and 12 ft, and they are 9 ft apart. Each tile covers 4 ft². How many tiles does he need?
items.e: Area: 12 × (20 + 12) × 9 = 12 × 32 × 9 = 144 ft². Tiles: 144 ÷ 4 = 36.

items.q: A kite is made of two triangles that share a 30 in rod down the middle. Each triangle is 10 in tall, measured from the rod. How much paper covers the kite?
items.e: Each triangle: base 30 in (the rod), height 10 in: 12 × 30 × 10 = 12 × 300 = 150 in². Two triangles: 2 × 150 = 300 in².

items.q: A wooden sign is a rectangle 30 in long and 12 in tall with a triangle on one end, like an arrow. The triangle's base is the 12 in side, and it sticks out 8 in. What is the area of the sign?
items.e: Rectangle: 30 × 12 = 360 in². Triangle: 12 × 12 × 8 = 12 × 96 = 48 in². Total: 360 + 48 = 408 in².

items.q: A triangular sail has sides of 10 ft, 17 ft and 21 ft. The height to the 21 ft side is 8 ft. What is its area?
items.e: Use the 21 ft side as the base and the 8 ft height: A = 12 × 21 × 8 = 12 × 168 = 84 ft². The 10 ft and 17 ft sides are slanted, so they are not the height.
